Conda build using cellcutter0.2.13, zarr3 compatible. (#235)

files.patch:
@@ -25,25 +25,26 @@ homepage = "https://github.com/labsyspharm/cylinter"
 
 [tool.poetry.dependencies]
 python = ">=3.11,<3.14"
-cellcutter = "*"
+cellcutter = "=0.2.13"  # this version is compatible with Zarr3
 hdbscan = "*"
 joblib = "*"
 magicgui = "*"
 matplotlib = "*"
-napari = ">=0.9.0"  # newer napari versions handle scalebar metadata differently
+napari = ">=0.9.0"  # cylinter code compatible with newer napari versions that handle scalebar metadata differently
 numpy = "*"
 natsort = "*"
 numba = "*"
 pandas = "*"
 pyarrow = "*"
 pyqt6 = "*"
+pyqt6-qt6 = "*"  # 6.8.4 leads to frozen widget window sliders, but conda solve fails with 6.8.2
 pyyaml = "*"
 qtpy = "*"
 scikit-image = "*"
 scikit-learn = "*"
 seaborn = "*"
 umap-learn = "*"
-zarr = "*"
+zarr = ">=3"
 tifffile = "*"
 svglib = "*"
 pypdf2 = "*"

@@ -1,65 +0,0 @@
-{% set name = "cylinter" %}
-{% set version = "0.0.57" %}
-
-package:
-  name: "{{ name|lower }}"
-  version: "{{ version }}"
-
-source:
-  git_url: https://github.com/labsyspharm/cylinter.git
-  git_tag: v0.0.57
-
-build:
-  number: 0
-  script: 
-    - "{{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed -vv "
-  entry_points:
-    - cylinter=cylinter.cylinter:main
-  noarch: python
-channels:
-  - conda-forge
-requirements:
-  build:
-    - poetry
-  host:
-    - pip
-    - python
-    - poetry
-  run:
-    - python >=3.11,<3.14
-    - cellcutter
-    - hdbscan
-    - joblib
-    - magicgui
-    - matplotlib
-    - napari >0.8.0,<0.9.0  # newer napari versions handle scalebar metadata differently
-    - numpy
-    - natsort
-    - numba
-    - pandas
-    - pyarrow
-    - pyqt6
-    - ffmpeg
-    - pyyaml
-    - qtpy
-    - scikit-image
-    - scikit-learn
-    - seaborn
-    - umap-learn
-    - zarr >=2.18,<3  # CyLinter is written using the Zarr 2 API
-    - tifffile <2023.7 # ensuring Zarr 2 compatibility
-    - numcodecs
-    - svglib
-    - pypdf2
-    - imagecodecs  # MIBI data fails to be read without this
-    - opencv
-
-test:
-  imports:
-    - cylinter
-
-about:
-  home: https://labsyspharm.github.io/cylinter/
-  license: MIT
-  license_family: BSD
-  summary: Quality Control Software for Multiplex Microscopy
